defs.def: the action of asking for sth formally and politely （正式或礼貌的）要求，请求

ex.s: My parents urged me to get out of this so-called unhealthy habit, but their repeated requests fell on deaf ears.
ex.t: 父母劝我改掉这个所谓不健康的习惯，但他们的一再要求都被我当成了耳旁风。

ex.s: The teachers praised her, and friends gathered around her, requesting her to sing.
ex.t: 老师们称赞她，朋友们围在她身边，请求她唱歌。

ex.s: Current students, teachers (including retired) and staff can request items through ILL.
ex.t: 40岁出头的一个夜晚，我梦见一个穿红衣的高大女人走近我，递给我一袋颜料，告诉我开始画画。

ex.s: To speed up the process, please make sure the information you submit through the ILL Request Form is accurate.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画颜料的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: Items are picked up at one of our libraries — the one you selected in the ILL Request Form.
Please review the List of Available Projects and fill out the Group Project Request Form.
ex.t: 请查阅“可参与项目列表”并填写团体项目申请表。

ex.s: Make a request to the Registration Office.
ex.t: 梅卡在他的背包深处翻找，____25____拿出了一块士力架。

ex.s: My partner posted her request on the notice board of a local park.
ex.t: 我的搭档在当地公园的布告栏上发布了她的需求。

ex.s: But our insisting it’s   45   a window has kept them from   46   millions of requests to open the door.
ex.t: 我讨厌对孩子撒谎。

ex.s: You will be requested to upload a passport sized photograph as part of the online registration process.
ex.t: 你将被要求上传一张护照大小的照片作为在线注册过程的一部分。

ex.s: If your student ID card no longer works or has been damaged, or if you have changed your personal or programme details, you should call into the Student Administration Centre （SAC） to request a new one.
ex.t: 如果你的学生证卡不再工作或已损坏或者你更改了个人或课程详细信息你应该致电学生行政中心（SAC）申请新卡。

ex.s: If your card has been reported to the Police as stolen, please also call into the SAC to request a replacement, bringing with you a copy of your Police Crime Report paperwork.
ex.t: 如果你的卡已向警方报告被盗请也致电SAC申请换卡并带上一份警方犯罪报告文件副本。

ex.s: You are requested to use our online payment service.
ex.t: 你被要求使用我们的在线支付服务。

ex.s: Note: Replacement cards will be available for you to collect seven working days after making the request As a security measure, you are requested to collect your card in person at the SAC.
ex.t: 注意：换卡将在提出申请后七个工作日后可供领取作为安全措施你被要求亲自到SAC领取你的卡。

ex.s: Once the book you've requested is delivered to the nearest branch, they will inform you by e-mail, so you can pick it up.
ex.t: 通过这样的网络，图书馆利用配送车辆互相分享图书。

ex.s: If a popular magazine you want isn't offered and the library keeps a list of such requests, they may bring it in when enough interest is shown.
ex.t: 有些图书馆甚至外借玩具和游戏。

ex.s: What gave Vinnie confidence to make her request of President Lincoln? （    ）
ex.t: 第二天，薇妮就收到了总统的邀请。

ex.s: How did President Lincoln first respond to Vinnie's request? （    ）
ex.t: 她对具有挑战性的工作的兴趣。

ex.s: When I was 17， I read a magazine article about a museum called the McNay， once the home of a watercolorist named Marian McNay． She had requested the community to turn it into a museum upon her death． On a sunny Saturday， Sally and I drove over to the museum． She asked， "Do you have the address？ ""No， but I'll recognize it， there was a picture in the magazine．
ex.t: 马上下来！

ex.s: Departing from the Cannery: Tell time upon request
ex.t: 从罐头厂出发：具体时间请咨询

ex.s: Price: Available upon request
ex.t: 价格：请咨询

ex.s: The audience requested it.
ex.t: 观众要求的。

ex.s: They were polite requests for the latest game or toy.
ex.t: 这些都是礼貌地请求最新的游戏或玩具。

ex.s: Learning to learn A polite interruption is usually framed as a request for permission to interrupt someone, often starting with If…, May I…?
ex.t: 学会学习 礼貌的打断通常是以请求允许打断别人的方式来表达的，常常以If…, May I…开头？

ex.s: Now talk about how the speakers make requests and refusals.
ex.t: 现在讨论说话者是如何提出请求和拒绝的。

ex.s: If I’m talking to a close friend, I can use short requests, like “Open the window”—our relationship is close and we’re equals, so I only need a few words to bridge the gap between us.
ex.t: 如果我在和一个亲密的朋友说话，我可以用简短的请求，比如＂开窗＂——我们的关系很近，我们是平等的，所以我只需要几个词就能拉近我们之间的距离。

ex.s: A necessity B possibility C obligation D request E advice F intention 2 Read the passage and fill in the blanks with suitable modal verbs in the box.
ex.t: A 必要性 B 可能性 C 义务 D 请求 E 建议 F 意图 2 阅读文章，用方框中合适的情态动词填空。

ex.s: Can you report others’ statements, requests, or questions fluently and accurately?
ex.t: 你能流利准确地转述别人的陈述、请求或问题吗？

defs.def: a thing that you formally ask for 要求的事

ex.s: It may seem like a simple request to ask for salt and pepper at a meal
ex.t: 用餐时要求加盐加醋似乎是个简单的请求
